items.rule: For $25K, an accredited land trust or an organisation partnering with one
items.quote: accredited land trust or partnering with an accredited land trust

items.rule: For $10K, a land trust or a conservation organisation partnering with a land trust
items.quote: Any land trust (does not need to be accredited) or conservation organization partnering with a land trust may apply.

items.rule: Grant funds exclude land purchases and conservation easement acquisition costs
items.quote: does not fund fee acquisition or easement costs.

items.item: Project narrative describing methods and timeline
items.quote: A brief description of your methods and timeline
A simple budget for the $10,000 OR $25,000 award and budget justification for your project.
Grant recipients are required to submit brief, quarterly progress reports as well as a final report

answer.notes: The next RFP opens in January 2027. The current FAQ still links the 2026 application questions; the listed attachments come from that form and are also referenced in the current FAQ, but should be checked against the 2027 form when published. Narrative and budget together are limited to three pages; maps, photos and support letters are optional. March 1 at 11:59 p.m. is stated without a year, so due is blank. The RFP requires projects to contribute to bird conservation on private land; the FAQ also allows qualifying permanently protected public land with land-trust involvement and notes flexibility. The $10K track must build land-trust capacity and/or partnerships with the bird-conservation community. Indirect costs cannot exceed 10%. The funding period is normally one year, with extensions possible. The MOU is developed for each selected project.
